changed: Device Sync does less work on a large collection: when it checks your collection again during the same sync, it reuses what it worked out for records that have not changed, instead of preparing every record again.

added: `syncArchiveBodyForEntity`, `syncBodyForArchiveBody` and `syncRecordBlobForArchiveBody` split `syncBodyForEntity` and `syncRecordBlobForEntity` into the archive-shaped body and the projection from it. The existing functions return what they did.
changed: `CompendiumSyncStorage(memoizeSnapshots: true)` makes a later `snapshot()` reuse each entity record's blob and wire hash from the same instance's previous one when every input that built them is unchanged. It is off by default; the sync worker turns it on for its per-pass storage only. The returned snapshot is unchanged.
